prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, over-the-shoulder shot of a person holding a modern smartphone in their right hand, with the screen facing the camera in sharp focus. The phone displays a cloud storage app interface in Spanish, featuring the text “Tus recuerdos están a salvo” and several thumbnail images, including a skateboard and colorful artwork. The person’s hand and part of their dark sleeve are visible, but their face and body are out of frame, creating a sense of anonymity. The background is softly blurred with cool, muted tones, suggesting an outdoor urban environment in the early evening or morning, with diffused natural light lending a calm, contemplative mood. The composition emphasizes the interaction between human and technology, with a shallow depth of field drawing attention to the phone’s screen and its contents. The overall style is cinematic and modern, with a focus on clarity, subtle color contrast, and a sense of everyday life captured in a fleeting moment.
